name: Into Your Heart
source:
"Into Your Heart" delves deep into the human psyche through Carl Jung’s shadow archetypes, where each character embodies a dark aspect of the protagonist’s mind—and that of the audience. Every interaction uncovers hidden facets of his soul, forcing him to confront his deepest fears and repressed desires. Your choices won’t just define his relationships but also his internal battle between light and darkness.

[From [url=https://mereszhka.itch.io/into-your-heart]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《走进你的心》通过卡尔·荣格的影子原型深入探讨了人类的心灵，其中每个角色都体现了主角和观众心灵的阴暗面。每一次互动都会揭露他灵魂隐藏的一面，迫使他面对他最深的恐惧和压抑的欲望。你的选择不仅会决定他的人际关系，还会决定他内心光明与黑暗之间的斗争。

[来自[url=https://mereszhka.itch.io/into-your-heart]Itch.io[/url]]
